info.title: Platform 5E API
info.description:
Backend of **Platform 5E**: teachers upload the material of a unit, generate 5E learning resources that cite it
(RAG), review them and export the approved ones to Moodle (Moodle XML) or Chamilo (SCORM 1.2).

**Authentication.** `POST /api/v1/accounts` or `POST /api/v1/sessions` return a bearer token. Click *Authorize* and
paste only the token. Private routes answer 401 without it.

**Errors.** Every error has the same shape: `{"error": {"code": "UNIT_NOT_FOUND", "message": "…"}}`. The `code` is
stable and in English; the `message` is shown to the teacher, so it is in Spanish.

**Stored values.** Review statuses (`pendiente`, `aprobado`, `descartado`), resource types (`item_opcion_multiple`…)
and difficulties (`basica`, `intermedia`, `avanzada`) are values saved in the database. They move to English in
Sprint 2 together with a data migration.

post.summary: Generate resources from the unit material
post.description:
Retrieves the most relevant chunks of the unit (BM25) and drafts the resources with the active generator.

Only resources whose claims cite valid chunks are kept; they are saved as `pendiente` for the teacher's review.
If the AI fails, the rule-based generator answers and `generator.fallback` is true. Without material the
request is rejected (400 NO_PROCESSED_MATERIAL) instead of inventing content.

post.summary: Export the approved resources of a unit
post.description:
Builds the file in the backend from the approved resources (fixed templates, never written by the AI),
records the download in the unit history and returns the file.

- `scorm_zip`: SCORM 1.2 package for Chamilo, one page per resource in 5E order; questions are graded.
- `moodle_xml`: Moodle question bank with the multiple-choice items.
- `documento`: printable HTML document of the approved unit resources, with evidence.
